paper_title: 1.4 Million Open-Source Distilled Reasoning Dataset to Empower Large   Language Model Training
caption: Distribution of reference answers and test cases in the dataset. Among the entries, 38.9% have reference answers, 21.9% include test cases, and 39.2% have neither reference answers nor test cases.
model_annotation: The pie chart displays the distribution of reference answers and test cases in a dataset, comparing three categories. The chart consists of three slices: "Null" labeled in red, "Have reference answer" labeled in blue, and "Have test case" labeled in green. The "Null" slice, colored red, accounts for approximately 39.2% of the chart. The "Have reference answer" slice, colored blue, accounts for approximately 38.9% of the chart. The "Have test case" slice, colored green, accounts for approximately 21.9% of the chart. The slices are ordered by size in descending order, with "Null" being slightly larger than "Have reference answer", and "Have test case" being the smallest. A legend in the upper-left corner matches the colors to their respective categories. Percentage labels are displayed inside each slice, and no slices are visually emphasized beyond their standard presentation.
